raw_meta_yaml:
{% set version = "2.4.10" %}
{% set posix = 'm2-' if win else '' %}

package:
  name: r-dlnm
  version: {{ version|replace("-", "_") }}

source:
  url:
    - {{ cran_mirror }}/src/contrib/dlnm_{{ version }}.tar.gz
    - {{ cran_mirror }}/src/contrib/Archive/dlnm/dlnm_{{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 3b75be8ce30b41c90a7b01f373d7a4ca9c5ddddb1739c5e6763c66ac2dfb0bf2

build:
  number: 0
  noarch: generic
  rpaths:
    - lib/R/lib/
    - lib/
  missing_dso_whitelist:
    - '*/R.dll'        # [win]
    - '*/Rblas.dll'    # [win]
    - '*/Rlapack.dll'  # [win]

requirements:
  build:
    - {{ posix }}zip               # [win]
    - cross-r-base {{ r_base }}    # [build_platform != target_platform]
  host:
    - r-base >=4.4.0
    - r-mgcv
    - r-nlme
    - r-tsmodel
  run:
    - r-base >=4.4.0
    - r-mgcv
    - r-nlme
    - r-tsmodel

test:
  commands:
    - $R -e "library('dlnm')"           # [not win]
    - "\"%R%\" -e \"library('dlnm')\""  # [win]

about:
  home: https://github.com/gasparrini/dlnm, http://www.ag-myresearch.com/package-dlnm
  license: GPL-2.0-or-later
  summary: Collection of functions for distributed lag linear and non-linear models.
  license_family: GPL2
  license_file:
    - {{ environ["PREFIX"] }}/lib/R/share/licenses/GPL-2
    - {{ environ["PREFIX"] }}/lib/R/share/licenses/GPL-3

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - conda-forge/r
    - dillonroach
